Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 19, 2026

Information you provide

If you submit a contact form or book a discovery call, Data Fort may receive your name, email address, business name, industry, and the reporting goals or challenges you choose to share.

How the information is used

Data Fort uses submitted information to respond to inquiries, understand whether the service is a fit, and prepare for a discovery conversation. Data Fort does not sell your personal information.

Third-party services

The site may use hosting and form-handling services, and booking links may send you to Calendly. Those services process information under their own policies.

Contact

For privacy questions, email hello@datafort.ca.
